name: How do I choose the best tile for shower floors to avoid slip hazards?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best tile for shower floors to avoid slip hazards?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathroom floors and shower pans, slip resistance is a vital decision factor. Look for tiles with a matte or textured finish and an appropriate Dynamic Coefficient of Friction rating for wet areas. Smaller tiles, such as mosaics or penny tiles, are especially effective for shower floors because the numerous grout lines provide natural traction under wet feet. Large-format polished tiles look sleek on main floors and walls, but polished surfaces become slippery when wet, requiring careful placement or non-slip bath mats outside the shower zone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose textured, matte tiles or small mosaic patterns for shower floors, as the extra grout joints and tactile finish provide essential slip resistance when wet.
